text: ext:SCFStage a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ext:WorkChainStep ; rdfs:comment "Converged-SCF stage (fleur.mpds or crystal.mpds). Precondition step: every property workflow reading a converged charge density must start from one of these (pitfalls 30, 22)." .
ext:MAEStage a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ext:WorkChainStep ; rdfs:comment "Magnetic-anisotropy stage: magnetization-rotation scan with spin-orbit coupling on the converged density." .
ext:EOSStage a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ext:WorkChainStep ; rdfs:comment "Equation-of-state stage: volume scan of the relaxed cell; the E(V) fit yields the bulk modulus." .
ext:ForceStage a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ext:WorkChainStep ; rdfs:comment "Force/stress stage: single-point forces and stress tensor on the converged density." .

ext:PhononStage a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ext:WorkChainStep ; rdfs:comment "Phonon stage: finite-displacement frequency calculation; requires the fully relaxed geometry, imaginary modes route back to geometry optimization (pitfalls 25, 27)." .

ext:MAEWorkflow a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ext:ComputationalWorkflow ; rdfs:comment "Magnetic anisotropy energy: converged SCF, then the magnetization-rotation scan, then the MAE convergence gate." .
ext:EOSWorkflow a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ext:ComputationalWorkflow ; rdfs:comment "Equation of state / bulk modulus: relaxed and converged SCF, then the volume scan." .
ext:ForceWorkflow a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ext:ComputationalWorkflow ; rdfs:comment "Atomic forces (and stress): converged SCF on the relaxed geometry, then the single-point force evaluation." .
ext:wc_fleur_scf a ext:SCFStage .
ext:wc_crystal_scf a ext:SCFStage .
ext:wc_fleur_mae a ext:WorkChainStep, ext:MAEStage ; rdfs:comment "fleur.mae: MAE magnetization-rotation scan with spin-orbit coupling; consumes the converged SCF wavefunction." .
ext:wc_fleur_mae_conv a ext:WorkChainStep, ext:MAEStage ; rdfs:comment "fleur.mae_conv: convergence check of the MAE rotation scan; the anisotropy is reported only after it passes." .
ext:wc_fleur_eos a ext:WorkChainStep, ext:EOSStage ; rdfs:comment "fleur.eos: volume scan of the relaxed cell; equation of state and bulk modulus from the E(V) fit." .
ext:wc_fleur_forces a ext:WorkChainStep, ext:ForceStage ; rdfs:comment "fleur.forces: single-point forces and stress tensor on the converged density of the relaxed geometry." .

ext:wc_phonopy_fleur a ext:WorkChainStep, ext:PhononStage ; rdfs:comment "phonopy.fleur: finite-displacement phonon frequencies via phonopy on the FLEUR engine; requires the fully relaxed geometry." .

ext:wf_fleur_mae a ext:MAEWorkflow ; ext:hasStep ext:wc_fleur_scf, ext:wc_fleur_mae, ext:wc_fleur_mae_conv ; rdfs:comment "FLEUR route: fleur.mpds SCF + relaxation, then the MAE rotation scan, then the MAE convergence gate." .
ext:wf_fleur_eos a ext:EOSWorkflow ; ext:hasStep ext:wc_fleur_scf, ext:wc_fleur_eos ; rdfs:comment "FLEUR route: fleur.mpds SCF + geometry optimization, then the EOS volume scan." .
ext:wf_fleur_forces a ext:ForceWorkflow ; ext:hasStep ext:wc_fleur_scf, ext:wc_fleur_forces ; rdfs:comment "FLEUR route: fleur.mpds SCF + relaxation, then the force/stress evaluation." .

ext:wf_fleur_phonon a ext:PhononWorkflow ; ext:hasStep ext:wc_fleur_scf, ext:wc_phonopy_fleur ; rdfs:comment "FLEUR/phonopy route: converged SCF + fully relaxed geometry, then phonopy finite displacements; complements the existing CRYSTAL FREQCALC route." .

ext:prop_magnetic_anisotropy a base:Property ; base:hasName "Magnetic anisotropy energy"^^xsd:string ; base:hasCategory "magnetic"^^xsd:string ; base:hasUnits "meV/formula unit"^^xsd:string ; base:hasDomain "magnetism"^^xsd:string ; ext:realizedBy ext:wf_fleur_mae ; rdfs:comment "Anisotropy energy from the magnetization-rotation scan; easy-axis orientation follows the minimum of the E(phi) curve." .

ext:prop_bulk_modulus a base:Property ; base:hasName "Bulk modulus"^^xsd:string ; base:hasCategory "mechanical"^^xsd:string ; base:hasUnits "GPa"^^xsd:string ; base:hasDomain "mechanics"^^xsd:string ; ext:realizedBy ext:wf_fleur_eos ; rdfs:comment "Isothermal bulk modulus from the equation-of-state fit of the volume scan." .

ext:prop_forces a base:Property ; base:hasName "Atomic forces and stress"^^xsd:string ; base:hasCategory "mechanical"^^xsd:string ; base:hasUnits "eV/angstrom (forces), GPa (stress)"^^xsd:string ; base:hasDomain "mechanics"^^xsd:string ; ext:realizedBy ext:wf_fleur_forces ; rdfs:comment "Single-point forces and stress tensor on the converged density of the relaxed geometry." .

ext:prop_phonon_spectrum a base:Property ; base:hasName "Phonon spectrum"^^xsd:string ; base:hasCategory "vibrational"^^xsd:string ; base:hasUnits "THz"^^xsd:string ; base:hasDomain "vibrations"^^xsd:string ; ext:realizedBy ext:wf_crystal_phonon, ext:wf_fleur_phonon ; rdfs:comment "Vibrational frequencies (phonon bands); imaginary modes route back to the geometry-optimization precondition (pitfalls 25, 27)." .
